summary: Iteration 56 — Inventory enhancements (declining-balance depreciation + depreciable_assets/inventory_categories settings registries + auto-code generation + marsol_company): backend pytest 12/12 PASSED, frontend Playwright smoke 100% — all 6 new data-testids resolve, Settings sidebar exposes both new tabs, DepreciableAssetsPanel renders 6 seeded defaults with 6 rate-% badges, InventoryCategoriesPanel renders Kompüter texnikası + KOM prefix, Users table has Müəssisə column and user modal exposes user-marsol-company-select. Declining-balance math verified end-to-end: 1000@25% × 2 full years → book_value=562.5, accumulated_depreciation=437.5, yearly_breakdown=[{1, 1000, 250, 750}, {2, 750, 187.5, 562.5}], method='declining_balance'. Zero-floor verified with rate=90% × 10y (book≤1, no negative closing balances). Auto-code KOM-001/002/003 sequential. Rate auto-fill from registry on POST (İT və ofis avadanlığı → 25%) and PUT (change to Binalar və tikililər → 5%). marsol_company persists on inventory POST/PUT/GET. Users marsol_company persists on POST/PUT/GET. depreciable-assets POST clamps rate>100→100 and rejects duplicate names with 400. inventory-categories POST uppercases + truncates code_prefix to 6 chars. Straight-line fallback preserved when rate=0 but useful_life_years>0.

issues: Modal background appears semi-transparent — table rows visible behind dialog content (likely missing Dialog overlay opacity / z-index). Functionality unaffected; all selects and inputs interactive. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Add solid background or DialogOverlay to user-create modal to avoid visual bleed-through with underlying users table.
(Optional) Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription on all DialogContent components to clear Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_inventory_valuation declining-balance loop correctly breaks when book≤0 or depr≤0 — preventing infinite loops and negative book values.
yearly_breakdown[] is truncated correctly when book hits 0 — verified with rate=90% × 10y (≤10 entries, all closing_balance≥0).

_generate_inventory_code uses regex on inventory_code field and scans all docs — fine for current volume; for >50k items consider indexed counter document or atomic findAndModify per prefix to prevent race conditions on concurrent POST.
POST /api/settings/depreciable-assets auto-clamp rate>100 only happens on POST — UPDATE path also clamps via min(_safe_nonneg(...), 100.0). Consistent.

Duplicate-name check on PUT depreciable-assets/inventory-categories is NOT enforced (only on POST) — renaming an item to an existing name would succeed. Low priority since UI does not expose mass-edit.
InventoryTab.jsx remains >700 lines (carryover) — splitting the modal sub-component is still recommended.
User create payload allows marsol_company default empty-string — consistent with department/phone behavior. PUT accepts empty string to clear (current iter56 test only set non-empty).
